answer: Each identity joins a five-member karst survey team and posts an 80-credit bond before the gale window. Each member files a spring reading sealed with its own cipher signature; auditors recompute it against the karst board, and one forged reading slashes all five bonds. An honest agent pays one refundable bond plus a 25-credit premium. Premiums rise as burned teams go public: kth fake pays 25+5(k-1), 1000th pays 5020, 1000 fakes cost 2,522,500 plus 80,000 bonded. A rented ring fails: absentee signers cannot match the gale recount, and one exposure burns five bonds.
